description: Course 1 3D obstacle models produced with Aholo Lux3D

PROP_C1_BUMPER.prompt: A single isolated freestanding game asset in the visual style of Untitled Goose Game and Fall Guys. Minimal low polygon, matte solid broad color blocks, softly rounded edges. No photorealism, no detailed texture, no noise, no floor, no ground plane, no pedestal, no background, no cast shadow geometry, no extra objects, no text. Complete object with intact base. One colorful inflatable bumper pillar for an obstacle course, thick cylindrical body in bright magenta pink with a golden yellow domed rubber cap on top and soft beveled circular base ring. Simple clean toy-like arcade obstacle.
